parameter_origins: All new grid values, feature windows, floors/caps, family definitions, split and objectives were fixed in SEARCH_PLAN before adaptive results; not inferred from later market results. Grid anchors are explanatory round-number hypotheses, not independently validated economic constants.
user_intent: volatility adaptation, avoid causal downtrends and buy recovery; test against original OR MA/breakout family.
observed_original_comparators: reference20/120/.02/.02/90/.08/5 and earlier full-training winner30/40/0/.02/10/.06/5, recomputed here with fixed parameters.
causal_volatility: ATR14 or RV20, current signal-close data and past data only; vol floor.005 cap.15; stop fraction clip(multiplier*vol,.03,.35).
trend: close>MAslow and MAslow >= its value slope5/10/20 bars ago.
recovery: past60-close-peak drawdown, previous20-bar maximum >=2*currentvol, close above previous5-close maximum.
diagnostic_regimes: previous close/MA60 and previous MA60 versus20 bars earlier; fixed before adaptive results; not trading filters except separately specified family rules.
supplemental_reporting_metric: positive_stock_days_log_capture added only to reporting after discovering that predeclared up-regime stock return denominator was negative; contemporaneous realized positive days, never used for strategy selection or trade filters, not a win rate.
selection_status: all training selections are finite-grid in-sample; chronological split uses already observed data and carries portfolio state.
